title: Buddhas Birthday
speaker: Nomon Tim Burnett
summary: The talk's main teaching is that every moment of life has the quality of birth, where we're fully alive and present, and this realization can help us approach our lives with equanimity and kindness. By embracing this perspective, we can find freedom in our relationships and experiences, recognizing that each person is constantly being reborn into new moments of life. This understanding encourages us to accept the impermanence of all things, including our own mortality, and to cultivate mindfulness and presence in our daily lives.
